# Outright Landscape Construction

> Outright Landscape Construction is a C-27 landscape contractor (CSLB #1073845) based in Covina, California. Founded in 2020, the company serves communities across the San Gabriel Valley.

## Contact

- Website: https://outrightlandscape.com/
- Phone: (626) 343-6028
- Email: office@outrightlandscape.com
- Location: Covina, CA 91722
- License: CSLB #1073845, C-27 Landscaping Contractor

## Services

- Landscaping and yard renovation
- Hardscaping, pavers, walkways, patios, and retaining walls
- Irrigation and sprinkler installation or repair
- Turf and sod installation
- Outdoor-living projects

## Service area

Covina, West Covina, Glendora, San Dimas, La Verne, Azusa, Claremont, Diamond Bar, Walnut, Pomona, Pasadena, Arcadia, Monrovia, Duarte, El Monte, Baldwin Park, Temple City, Rowland Heights, Charter Oak, and nearby San Gabriel Valley communities. Project availability varies by location and schedule.

## Estimates and verification

Project pricing and schedules depend on site conditions, materials, access, permits, and scope. Contact the company for a project-specific estimate. Verify current license status through the California Contractors State License Board and request any bond, insurance, warranty, or manufacturer documentation that matters for a project.
